_comment: Night 4-9 events: repetition, emotional tagging, contextual meaning, cue recognition, relational danger. Player starts seeing patterns and conditions.

events.title: Claw Marks on the Trees
events.description: High on the bark of several trees along the trail, you notice deep gouges. Long, parallel scratches — carved by something with large claws. No animal is visible. The air smells faintly of musk.

cues.description: Deep claw marks carved at shoulder height on multiple trees
Faint musky animal odor on the bark

choices.text: Recognize the cue and move off-trail

outcome.description: Your experience tells you: claw marks mean recent bear activity. You detour through the underbrush and emerge safely further down the trail.

memory_reward.title: Bear Claw Marks
memory_reward.description: Claw marks on bark = bear territory nearby. Reliable warning cue.
hidden_traits: height of marks indicates bear size

cue_tags.description: deep parallel scratches on bark at shoulder height

outcome.description: Around the next bend, a bear blocks the path. Without preparation, the encounter goes badly.

memory_reward.title: Claw Marks Warning
memory_reward.description: Claw marks on bark meant a bear was close. I should have known. Ignored the sign and paid for it.

events.title: Fire, Smoke, and the Hollow Tree
events.description: You're near a small fire you built. Downwind, a hollow tree buzzes quietly. But you notice something: the bees near the smoke from your fire seem sluggish, barely moving.

cues.description: Bees near smoke moving slowly, barely flying
Smoke from your small fire drifting toward the tree
Usual buzzing is muted, quieter near the smoke

choices.text: Use your fire to smoke the nest and carefully take the honey

outcome.description: With controlled smoke directed at the hollow, the bees slow and retreat inside. You carefully extract several combs of honey. Rich, thick, and sweet — worth the patience.

memory_reward.title: Bees + Smoke
memory_reward.description: Smoke calms bees. Fire smoke near hive = safe to approach and harvest honey.

choices.text: Interesting — but too risky. Move on.

outcome.description: You watch for a moment. The smoke really does seem to affect them. A useful thing to remember.

memory_reward.title: Smoke and Bees
memory_reward.description: Smoke from fire seemed to slow the bees down. Didn't test it fully.

events.title: Wolf in the Open
events.description: You step out of the treeline into a broad, sunlit meadow. In the middle of the grass, a single grey wolf watches you. It doesn't move. The sun is high.

cues.description: Single grey wolf, sitting, watching you from meadow center
Bright midday sun, open ground, no cover nearby

choices.text: Recognize the context and walk steadily across — it won't hunt in daylight in the open

outcome.description: The wolf watches as you cross. When you're near the center it turns and lopes away into the far trees. You were right — wolves hunt differently in open daylight.

memory_reward.title: Wolf (Meadow, Daylight)
memory_reward.description: Lone wolf in open meadow at midday. Watched me but didn't approach. Wolves are less dangerous in open spaces during daytime.

outcome.description: You back into the trees. The wolf disappears. You lose an hour finding another route.

memory_reward.title: Wolf in Meadow
memory_reward.description: Lone wolf in open meadow. Retreated — didn't investigate its behavior in this context.
hidden_traits: may be safer in open during day

events.title: The Same Mushrooms Again
events.description: Pale mushrooms with brown spots. You've seen these before. This time you're more confident — you remember eating them and feeling fine.

cues.description: Pale mushrooms with brown spots — identical to the ones you've seen before

choices.text: Eat them — you've done this before with no ill effects

outcome.description: Familiar. Safe. Your confidence in identifying them grows. The pattern reinforces itself.

memory_reward.title: Spotted Mushrooms
memory_reward.description: Eaten twice, both times fine. Growing more reliable identification. Pale, brown-spotted = edible.
hidden_traits: third exposure will fully confirm reliability

events.title: Stagnant Pool
events.description: A wide pool of still water sits in a hollow. It looks dark and greenish. No current, no sounds. A dead bird lies at the edge. You're thirsty.

cues.description: Greenish, murky standing water — no current
Dead bird at the water's edge

choices.text: Recognize the signs and do not drink

outcome.description: Your memory of the clean stream guides you — this is wrong. Still, dark, smelly. You move on, thirsty but wise.

memory_reward.title: Stagnant Water
memory_reward.description: Still, dark, greenish water with dead animals nearby = dangerous. Distinct from fast, clear water.

outcome.description: Within hours, violent cramps. You spend the rest of the day sick and barely moving. Terrible lesson.

memory_reward.title: Poisoned Water
memory_reward.description: Drank stagnant, dark water. Got extremely sick. Still water can be poisonous.

events.title: Honey Left on a Rock
events.description: Someone has left what appears to be a honeycomb on a flat stone by the trail. The golden comb gleams, untouched. A low buzzing comes from nearby trees.

cues.description: No one else visible — why was this left?

outcome.description: The buzzing erupts. The honey was being guarded. A swarm pours from the canopy. This was near their territory all along.

memory_reward.title: Honey Near Bee Territory
memory_reward.description: Honey left near buzzing trees = bee territory. Taking it without checking was a mistake.

choices.text: Remember: honey + buzzing = danger. Leave it.

outcome.description: You connect the cues. Honey here, buzzing nearby. This is their territory. You leave it and walk calmly past. The bees ignore you.

memory_reward.title: Bees + Honey Context
memory_reward.description: Honey near buzzing trees = active bee territory. Recognizing the combination prevented an attack.

encounters.title: The Marked Trail
encounters.description: Fresh claw marks on the trees ahead. Deep, wide, at shoulder height. The musky smell is present. You need to decide your path.
encounters.success_text: You read the territory markers and detour. No bear encounter at all.
encounters.failure_text: You ignore the marks. A bear confrontation follows — unprepared.
encounters.partial_text: You hesitate but get through. Stressed, but uninjured.

encounters.title: Desperate Thirst
encounters.description: You haven't had water in hours. There are two sources: a dark murky pool, and a distant sound of running water. The running water is far — the pool is right here.
encounters.success_text: Your memory of the clear stream and the poisoned pool guides you. You hike to the running water. Clean. Worth it.
encounters.failure_text: You drink from the pool. Hours later, you're violently ill.
encounters.partial_text: You hesitate, drink a tiny amount, and suffer a minor illness.

encounters.title: The Hungry Day
encounters.description: You're low on food. A bee nest is visible — full of honey. You have a lit torch. Do you know what to do?
encounters.success_text: You use the torch to smoke the nest gently. The bees retreat. You harvest the honey safely. A full meal.
encounters.failure_text: You approach without smoke. The bees attack immediately.
encounters.partial_text: You try to use smoke but do it wrong — partial stings, some honey.
